description: [Read · free] Given a target person, find the shortest warm-intro path through your engager network. Walks coworker (shared current company) + alumni (shared past company / school) edges. Up to 3 hops. Paths only exist where job history is on file, and engagers collected from reactions/comments usually have none: the response's `coverage` says how many candidates (the target, and engagers tied to the target's companies) have job history, and when missing data may hide paths `_meta.next_step` names enrich_people with the exact person_ids to pass and its credit cost. Pure DB read — no LinkedIn pull, no credits charged.

max_hops.description: Max path length (1=direct, 2=one intermediate, 3=two intermediates). Default 2.

name: get_outreach_path
